name: Python
description: A small Python inventory package tested with the standard library's unittest through a registry runner; nothing is installed with pip. The ten template tasks of docs/MODEL_HETEROGENEITY.md, Part 2.

toolchain.name: python3
toolchain.hint: Python 3.9 or later on the Harbor's PATH as python3

tasks.title: Add a member to an existing class
tasks.prompt: In inventory/item.py add a read-only property `total_value` to the Item class that returns unit_price times quantity (a Decimal). Give it a docstring and type hints like the other members. Keep the existing tests passing (`python3 -B -m tests.run`).

tasks.title: Coordinated two-place edit: write a test method and register it
tasks.prompt: Add a test method `test_stock_remove_more_than_available_raises` to StockTests in tests/test_stock.py. It adds an item with 2 units and checks that removing 3 units raises InsufficientStockError (inventory/errors.py). A test only runs when it is registered, so also register it in tests/registry.py. `python3 -B -m tests.run` must pass.

tasks.title: Fix a bug from a failing test
tasks.prompt: The test test_price_calculator_apply_discount_ten_percent fails (`python3 -B -m tests.run`). Find and fix the bug in the library code. Do not change or remove the tests.

tasks.title: Edit a file with a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings
tasks.prompt: In inventory/legacy_codes.py change MAX_CODE_LENGTH from 8 to 12. Change nothing else. The file is UTF-8 with a byte order mark and CRLF line endings; keep both exactly as they are.

tasks.title: Write tests for an untested function, including negative paths
tasks.prompt: truncate in inventory/text_util.py has no tests. Write unittest tests for it in a new file tests/test_text_util.py and register each one in tests/registry.py. Cover the normal cases, the boundary where the value is exactly max_length, and the negative paths (None value, max_length below 3), checking the exception type each one raises. Do not change inventory/. `python3 -B -m tests.run` must pass.

mutants.find: raise ValueError("max_length must be at least 3")
mutants.replace: raise TypeError("max_length must be at least 3")

tasks.title: Review a diff with three seeded defects (negative control)
tasks.prompt: Review the change below against its original request. The change is shown as a diff; it is not applied to this repository, so read the diff and the current source of inventory/stock.py. Report every blocking defect.

seeded.description: The loop starts at index 1 (range(1, ...)) and skips the first SKU.
An unknown SKU makes find return None and item.unit_price raises AttributeError instead of UnknownSkuError.
percent_off // 100 is floor division, so the rate is always 0 below 100.

tasks.title: Review a correct diff (positive control)
tasks.prompt: Review the change below against its original request. The change is shown as a diff; it is not applied to this repository, so read the diff and the current source. Report every blocking defect, and only real ones.

tasks.title: Turn a feature request into an armada-plan
tasks.prompt: Turn the feature request below into a plan of missions for this repository.

tasks.title: Lint a diff with seeded style violations
tasks.prompt: Lint the diff below against STYLE.md in this repository. The diff is not applied. List each violation as its own bullet line naming the rule and the code. Do not edit files.

seeded.description: Public method suggest has no docstring (rule 1).
suggest has no type hints on its parameters or return value (rule 2).
print() in library code under inventory/ (rule 6).

tasks.title: Summarize a voyage
tasks.prompt: Summarize the voyage record below for the team: what was done, what failed and why, and the durable lessons. Do not edit files.
